questions.question: God sent the prophet Jehu with a message for King Baasha of Israel. What did God remind Baasha He had done for him?

answers.text: Raised him from nothing to be ruler
Helped him win his wars with Asa
Gave him the city of Gibbethon

questions.question: When the army camped at Gibbethon heard that Zimri had killed King Elah, what did they do that day?

answers.text: Swore their loyalty to King Zimri
Went home to their own tribes

questions.question: After King Ahab of Israel married Jezebel, which false god did he serve and worship?
In the days of King Ahab, what did it cost Hiel to rebuild the city of Jericho?

answers.text: His firstborn son and his youngest son
All the silver and gold he owned
His house and his fields in Bethel
